---
name: New issue
about: A crash, a glitch or slow play is reported from the launcher (REPORT A BUG), not from here. Anything else starts here.
---
STOP: is this about a crash, a glitch, or slow or stuttering play?

Then do not write this issue by hand. Open the launcher and choose REPORT A BUG.
It runs the game once, writes a report file, and opens this page for you with
your system's description filled in.

Issues about those without the launcher's report file will be closed.

For anything else (a question, an idea, a request), delete this text and write away.
